Solid-State Battery Market Outlook 2026–2031

Published 2026-04-02 by Fixture Market Research.

The global solid-state battery market is projected to grow from $1.1 billion in 2026 to $8.3 billion by 2031, a compound annual growth rate of 49.8%.

Segments

  • Automotive is expected to account for 71% of 2031 revenue.
  • Consumer electronics adoption is projected to begin with premium wearables in 2027.
  • The leading announced production commitment is Nimbus Motors' 12 GWh plant in Ohio, scheduled to reach full output in 2029.

Analysts flag sintering yield as the single largest cost risk across every manufacturer surveyed.
